g.text: Complete required work/checks and declare review scope
review prepare: select the scope and governing basis
Request whole-change review of the prepared scope
review show: read the basis and outstanding findings
Return scope, current issues and supporting summaries
Inspect selected files and assess the whole change
review record: update judgment and explicit applicability
Return applicable approval for the complete current candidate
Request distinct final Verify with current evidence
Assess whether evidence supports the completion claim
verification record: save current acceptance support and rationale
Confirm the actual committed Verify result
Return the supported final Verification reference
change complete: declare closeout within existing authority
Confirm recorded completion and its verification basis
